page: Amazon Web Services is4gen.xlarge is a storage-optimized virtual machine powered by AWS Graviton processors based on the arm64 ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 architecture. Operating on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, the instance provides 4 dedicated physical cores running at 2.5 GHz with one thread per core. Memory allocation stands at 24.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 1:6 vCPU-to-memory ratio (6.0 GB per core). The hardware configuration includes a 3,750 GB local NVMe SSD and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. The processor features 64 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache, with hardware acceleration support for AES cryptography, while lacking x86-specific vector instruction sets.

Benchmark evaluations indicate compute throughput suited for baseline processing rather than compute-intensive tasks. The instance achieved an average stress-ng single-core score of 1519.48, though multi-core performance measured 6055.17, placing it in the lower quartile. Geekbench scores registered at 961.0 for single-core and 3226.0 for multi-core. Large-block memory bandwidth demonstrated average capability at 73.07 GB/sec for read-only operations and 35.12 GB/sec for writes. PassMark database operations scored in the middle tier at 2615.53, alongside a Redis SET throughput of 4.78 million operations per second, while LLM inference and heavy compression tasks fell into lower performance percentiles.

The primary value proposition of the is4gen.xlarge centers on dense, high-capacity local NVMe storage paired with dedicated arm64 cores. By integrating 3,750 GB of high-speed local solid-state storage within a moderate four-core footprint, the instance provides strong resource density for storage-bound applications without forcing over-provisioning of CPU cores. The clear tradeoff is modest compute and vector processing throughput. Consequently, the instance is well suited for high-throughput databases, search engine nodes, distributed file system storage, real-time log ingestion, and data streaming caches.
description: Amazon Web Services is4gen.xlarge is a storage-optimized instance powered by a 4-core AWS Graviton Neoverse-N1 arm64 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. It includes 24.0 GB of RAM, providing a 1:6 core-to-memory ratio, alongside a dedicated 3,750 GB local NVMe SSD and 6 Gbps baseline networking on the Nitro hypervisor. Benchmark data reflects average memory bandwidth and database execution, reaching 73.07 GB/sec large-block reads and 2615.53 on PassMark database tasks, alongside moderate single-core throughput. Conversely, multi-threaded CPU tests and compression benchmarks register lower relative scores. The configuration trades raw CPU compute power for high storage capacity and I/O density. It is specifically suited for localized database engines, distributed storage systems, log analytics, and caching layers requiring immediate access to dense local solid-state storage.
